verdicts.summary: Installs cleanly and its own plugin code loads, but it breaks the official Desktop boot. Rolled back; not deployed to any instance.
whatWorked: pnpm install succeeded offline-from-cache in 12.8s; all native deps landed as real directories inside the instance (@node-rs/jieba, sqlite-vec, undici, @deepseek-ai/schemastery)
@node-rs/jieba loaded fine, so there is no Electron/N-API ABI problem
the plugin initialised and wrote <instance>\dsh-home\memory\ with memory.db (118784 bytes), conversations/, records/, scenes/chat, scenes/work and memory.log

memory.log records: tokenizer = jieba word-level + CJK bigram union; retrieval fell back from hybrid to keyword FTS5 BM25 because embedding is disabled; distillation route deepseek-official/deepseek-flash; tools registered memory_search / conversation_search / memory_read_scene; 'L0~L3 layered distillation memory plugin ready'
dataDir resolved to $DSH_HOME/memory inside the instance, confirming the per-instance isolation model would hold if it booted

decisiveErrors: Error invoking remote method 'dsh-desktop:boot': Error: cannot create effect on inactive context
Network service crashed or was terminated, restarting service
failure.earlierWarning: [warn] [memory] memory-mode switch registration failed (keeping all on): settings.register is not a function

verdicts.rootCause: Version skew. dsh-layered-memory 0.9.2 targets the 0.1.2-alpha.x host API surface (its peerDependencies all say ^0.1.2-alpha.1). On 0.1.7-alpha.1 the settings service no longer exposes register(), and something in the plugin's composition runs against a Cordis context that has already been deactivated, so the desktop boot effect fails and the renderer crashes.
verdicts.abEvidence: Same instance (daily), same credentials, same runner. With cyber + layered-memory: 4 processes, title 'DeepSeek Harness is unavailable', port 19411 not listening, 2102-byte error log. After restoring package.json.pre-dsh-layered-memory (cyber only): 6 processes, title 'DeepSeek Harness', port 19411 listening, 0-byte log.
verdicts.classification: upstream incompatibility, not a Hub defect
options: do not install it on Desktop instances (current state)
obtain or build a dsh-layered-memory release whose peerDependencies match 0.1.7-alpha.1
keep using it on the live downstream fork D:\DSH-Desktop (0.1.2-beta.2), where it is known to work
verdicts.residue: instances\daily\dsh-home\memory\ remains from the trial run. It is inert because the bundle is no longer registered; delete it only if you want the instance pristine.

correctionToEarlierClaim: During the credential A/B I reported '0-byte log = no errors' for a run that later showed 1736 bytes containing 'dsh desktop host exited with 4294967295'. Those lines were written AFTER my observation window, and the same signature appears in logs of runs I deliberately stopped via manifests\launch-one-stop.flag. So 'host exited with 4294967295' is largely an artifact of my own stop path and must not be read as a spontaneous failure. The credential conclusion is unaffected because it rested on live process count and window visibility, not on the log.
toolingDefectFixed: install-instance-plugin.ps1 originally rewrote package.json from a fixed template, which would have silently dropped every previously registered plugin - installing a second plugin wiped the first. It now merges, and asserts after writing that every previously declared bundle survived. Verified: daily went from deps=[dsh-plugin-cyber] to deps=[dsh-plugin-cyber, dsh-layered-memory] with all four bundles intact.
